objective: Discover a materially higher-growth after-cost payoff from external shock propagation and Bybit absorption or overshoot, using one causal ML system rather than rescuing prior strategies.

economic_thesis.information_advantage: A completed Binance Futures displacement and aggressor-flow state can lead the Bybit executable fair value, while an excessive Bybit response can create a short-lived reversal payoff.
economic_thesis.action_advantage: One model compares continuation and reversal structural payoffs and may choose flat; it does not force a direction from the signal name.
economic_thesis.payoff: Continuation targets a frozen cross-venue fair-value or 1.5 shock-leg measured move. Reversal targets the pre-shock Bybit origin or frozen fair value. Both use a resting structural stop plus external-reference or opposite-displacement exits; no elapsed-time liquidation exists.
economic_thesis.why_it_can_scale_growth: The information unit is sub-second, cross-symbol and repeatable. Large forced displacements can produce payoff distances materially above round-trip cost, while direct after-cost selection suppresses ordinary low-edge shocks.

event_definition.basis: prior-only 10-minute EWM of log Bybit/Binance executable mids, shifted one completed 100ms state
event_definition.volatility: prior-only 10-minute EWM standard deviation of Binance 500ms returns and cross-venue fair-value gap
event_definition.shock: absolute completed Binance 500ms return exceeds both a symbol floor and 2.5 times prior volatility
event_definition.candidate_direction: sign of the completed Binance 500ms shock

execution_contract.signal_availability: the 100ms signal state completes before the fixed 500ms latency starts
execution_contract.entry: marketable Bybit BBO using a marketable-limit protection; execution uses the first actual Bybit BBO observed at or after the fixed activation boundary, an order with no quote within 1000ms expires while occupying the global pending slot, and a reversal order expires if its frozen structural anchor was already delivered
execution_contract.position_capacity: 10% of displayed opposing Bybit best-quote notional
execution_contract.resting_target: frozen at signal and entry from causal structural anchors
execution_contract.resting_stop: maximum of 8bp, 0.75 times shock magnitude and 1.5 times prior 500ms volatility, capped only for the initial screen at 80/100/160/160bp by symbol
discretionary_exits: external reference reversal after 500ms then first actual Bybit BBO
opposite displacement after 500ms then first actual Bybit BBO
execution_contract.source_boundary: open exposure is marked to executable Bybit BBO for NAV and remains strategy-open; it is not force-closed
execution_contract.one_global_slot: account arbitration sorts actual activation times across all symbols; a pending order blocks later activation until fill or expiry and an open position blocks every later entry until structural exit

features: signed cross-venue fair-value gap and gap z-score
signed Binance and Bybit aggressor flow
signed Binance and Bybit quote imbalance

model.family: one HistGradientBoostingRegressor with absolute-error loss over resolved continuation and reversal action rows
model.target: gross structural action return in basis points; all-in cost is subtracted only at account authorization
model.calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on the pre-2024 calibration date
model.action_selection: highest calibrated gross payoff among continuation and reversal; flat unless predicted gross minus cost exceeds the frozen margin
model.margin_selection: choose one margin from 0, 2, 4, 8, 12, 20 or 32bp by highest 24bp-cost account return on the second half of the calibration date, then winner-removed return, trade count and margin as deterministic tie breakers

account_contract.quantity_rule: NAV risk budget divided by structural stop plus selected round-trip cost, then capped by leverage and 10% displayed-BBO capacity
account_contract.winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% accepted event keys, at least one when positives exist, and rerun global-slot arbitration
account_contract.funding: not opened in the initial one-day pre-2024 screen; a survivor must add actual Bybit funding before rank eligibility

decision.advance: The selected 24bp calibration path and untouched 24bp confirmation path are both positive and confirmation has no forced liquidation. Expand unchanged across additional pre-2024 dates, add actual funding and freeze before immediate official 2024H1.
decision.retire: Otherwise retire this exact taker propagation/absorption route without adjacent threshold, target, stop, feature, model, risk, leverage or latency rescue.
